answer: Each seat must hold a bank account opened at least thirty days before the epoch. The seed names a random minute, the network wires $0.40 into that account with a four-letter reference in the statement text, and the seat has ninety minutes to read it back. Accounts opened in one branch batch share a routing prefix; such a group folds into one vote and forfeits 40,000 POA each. KYC runs $60 per account plus a $250 float held a month, so a thousand puppets cost $310,000 before writing a word. A harbor logs every hull that ties at its jetty, and a meadow of reeds is one root when you dig.
